findings.title: Public self-registration as admin role
findings.remediation: Restrict public RegisterRequest.role to customer/seller only.

findings.title: Header spoofing (X-User-Role: admin) without internal service token
findings.evidence: GET user-service /users with forged X-User-Role='admin' returned HTTP 401
findings.remediation: Require HMAC-verified X-Internal-Token alongside X-User-Id/X-User-Role headers.

findings.title: Unauthenticated internal endpoints & cross-user payment initiation
findings.remediation: Enforce require_internal_service or caller ownership/admin check on mutation endpoints.

findings.title: Rate Limiter bypass via rotating X-Forwarded-For header
findings.evidence: 5 requests with rotating X-Forwarded-For yielded statuses [200, 200, 200, 429, 429]
findings.remediation: Ignore untrusted X-Forwarded-For by default; trust X-Real-IP only behind NGINX.

findings.title: Weak password policy allows short numeric-only passwords
findings.remediation: Require >= 8 chars with at least one letter and one digit.

findings.title: Missing HTTP security headers & NGINX hardening directives
findings.remediation: Add nosniff/DENY/Cache-Control headers in Gateway and CSP/server_tokens off in NGINX.

findings.title: SQL Injection & Stored/Reflected XSS protection
findings.evidence: SQLi search HTTP 200 (matches=0), SQLi login HTTP 401, esc() present=True
findings.remediation: Use parameterized SQLAlchemy queries and HTML escaping on all rendered fields.

findings.title: JWT revocation enforcement & error trace non-disclosure
findings.evidence: post-logout dashboard HTTP 401, validation error HTTP 422, Traceback leaked=False
findings.remediation: Enforce JTI revocation check on Gateway and uniform sanitized error envelopes.
